info.title: CLST Trucking Gmail Load Lookup
info.description: Looks up CLST Trucking LLC load information in connected Gmail messages and attached rate-confirmation PDFs. Use this tool when a caller asks about a specific load, carrier pay, pickup, delivery, broker, equipment, miles, or load instructions. Only report details returned by the API; never invent missing fields. Treat rate as verified only when the returned answer explicitly confirms it from the PDF.

post.summary: Find load details in CLST Trucking Gmail and rate-confirmation PDFs
post.description: Searches connected Gmail and analyzes matching PDF attachments to answer a load question. Ask one focused question per call. Include the exact load number or broker name when the caller provides it. Do not state a rate is verified unless the API answer says it is verified.

question.description: The caller's question about a CLST Trucking load. Example: What are the pickup, delivery, and carrier pay details for load 12345?

query.description: Optional Gmail search query. Usually omit this so the backend builds a query from the question.

200.description: Answer based on matching Gmail messages and PDF attachments. An empty sources array means no matching messages were found.

answer.description: Natural-language answer grounded in the available email/PDF data.

CLSTApiKey.name: Authorization
CLSTApiKey.description: Set the value to: Bearer YOUR_CLST_API_KEY. Configure the actual secret in the RingCentral integration's authentication settings; do not put the key into the OpenAPI file.
